uniforms:
uniform 声明以贴近原始接口，但实际从未采样。
uniform highp sampler2D baseCurve;

uniform 避免 per-shot recompile
out vec3 Output;

uniform sampler2D uTexture
 *   histogram_ae.glsl: R/G/B 三通道，binding=1/2/3，uniform sampler2D inTexture
 *
 * 对应 reference implementation:
 *   buffers[0].bind(1) → R 通道 → binding=1
 *   buffers[1].bind(2) → G 通道 → binding=2
 *   buffers[2].bind(3) → B 通道 → binding=3
 *   glProg.setTexture("inTexture", input) → uniform sampler2D inTexture
 *   glProg.setVar("exposure", r, g, b, a) → uniform vec4 exposure
 *
 * 下采样：GLHistogram.resize=3，即 dispatch 时传入 w/3, h/3
 * 每个像素的 bin = floor(channel * exposure[i])，exposure[i] = histSize-1 = 255
 */

layout(local_size_x = 8, local_size_y = 8, local_size_z = 1) in;
